sentences.en: Creative people create, the non-creative plagiarize, all the others - translate.
sentences.zh: 创造者们创作，非创造者们剽窃，其他人 - 翻译。

sentences.en: If you plagiarise my sentences, then I will plagiarise yours.
sentences.zh: 如果你抄袭我的句子，那我就抄袭你的。

sentences.en: I admit that my book is plagiarised. I can't face my readers.
sentences.zh: 我承认我的书被抄袭了。我无法面对我的读者。
